name: Proton Saga (1985)
creation_method: Original Blender procedural panel meshes with user-supplied reference-image textures
accuracy_notes: Reference-led panel reconstruction with adjusted axle and roof proportions, three grille rails, clear headlamp covers, and red/clear/amber rear lamp sections. Headlamps, indicators, tail lamps and wheel surfaces use image-derived textures; compressed full reference images are embedded in the GLB. Geometry, reflections, cabin and trim remain approximate; this is not a factory scan, dimensionally certified vehicle or a 100% photographic match.
